[[File:Senta EP085.png|thumb|250px|Senta]]
(Japanese: '''センタ''' ''Senta'') is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[EP085|Fit To Be Tide]]''. He is [[Cissy]]'s assistant and younger brother. He was not given a name in the English [[dub]].

Senta lives on [[Mikan Island]] with his sister. He is known for playing practical jokes on visitors to the [[Mikan Gym]], including {{Ash}}. He thinks very highly of his sister and the rest of the {{pkmn|Trainer}}s in the [[Orange League|Orange Crew]]. Even when Ash informed him of his placing in the [[Indigo League]], Senta told him to not even compete in the Orange League, saying it was tougher unless he was an elite Trainer.

==Pokémon==
Senta has at least one Pokémon, as he held up a Poké Ball when he agreed to battle Ash before being interrupted by Cissy.
